about: [cold play] The first minute as a stranger meets it: the title, BEGIN, the look round on foot, E into the coupe, a drive up Grand Ave by hand (W, a turn, the handbrake, into a wall), the map on M, E out while moving. (The cursor's first move after the click on BEGIN is a tool artefact that pitches the eye: levelled once by eval.)

steps.eval: (async () => { const p = G.camera.position; const P = await import('/src/world/plan.js'); return JSON.stringify({x:+p.x.toFixed(1), z:+p.z.toFixed(1), d: P.districtAt(p.x,p.z).id, kmh: +(G.city.car.speed*3.6).toFixed(0)}); })()
